Boston Marathon on Instagram: "HEY BOSTON QUALIFIERS!👋 Zdeno Chara wants YOU to join him in adding meaning to your miles by participating in this year’s Qualified Runner for a Cause campaign.💪

Qualifiers of the 130th Boston Marathon presented by @BankofAmerica are encouraged to raise $2,620, a symbolic nod to the 26.2 miles of Boston’s historic course, or any amount in support of @TeamBAA or a nonprofit of your choice.🦄

For #Boston130, @ZeeChara33 is raising funds for the @ThomasESmithFoundation: “I’m very excited to be part of 2026 Boston Marathon, this year participating to raise awareness and support for the Thomas E. Smith Foundation, an organization dedicated to changing the lives of individuals and families living with paralysis. With your help, we will positively impact those who need us.”💙💛

Join Chara and #TeamBAA and run this year’s race for a deeper purpose by visiting the 🔗 in bio. #MeetTheMoment"
